# ontology-core

Use this skill when you need the canonical ontology, Common Node Schema, FQN conventions,
entity definitions, relationship types, confidence model, or ingestion gates for the
personal brain vault.

## Instructions

1. Treat raw materials as source input, not as durable knowledge.
2. Prefer Session-first modeling.
3. Only create durable nodes when the extracted item is reusable, attributable, and
   likely to matter beyond the original source.
4. Apply the canonical CNS and FQN conventions.
5. Use the local reference file in this folder as the source of truth.

## Local references

- `personal-brain-ontology.md`: the canonical ontology and modeling rules.
